name: MAILSPECTRA Synthetic Email Demonstration Set
purpose: Local product demonstrations and analyst workflow walkthroughs only.

safety.domains: All sample email domains use the reserved .test namespace.
safety.ip_addresses: IPv4 literals use RFC 5737 documentation ranges only.
safety.attachments: The only attachment is plain-text synthetic notes; no executable or macro-enabled files are included.
safety.links: All links use .test hostnames or RFC 5737 documentation IP addresses. Do not click or fetch message URLs.
safety.credentials: No real credentials, account details, or personal data are included.
safety.authentication: Authentication-Results and Received-SPF values are claims embedded in the synthetic message, not independently verified results.

operating_guidance.intelligence_mode: Use INTELLIGENCE_MODE=offline for a deterministic demo.
operating_guidance.model: Displayed ML classification and risk are application outputs from a demonstration-only, uncalibrated model; no expected score or verdict is prescribed by this manifest.
operating_guidance.handling: Use a disposable local database and storage directories. Do not mix demonstration cases with real evidence.

investigation_cues: No urgent credential or payment request
Embedded authentication pass claims remain unverified claims in a saved message
Documentation-range source and URL IP literals
Embedded authentication failure claims remain unverified claims in a saved message
